# Drag handles

The tools whose features have drag handles in the 3D view, and what each handle sets. [Drag handles](../guides/drag-handles.md) explains how to use them.

| Tool | Handles set |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Extrude](tools/extrude.md) | **Depth** |
| [Revolve](tools/revolve.md) | **Angle** |
| [Fillet](tools/fillet.md) | **Radius** |
| [Chamfer](tools/chamfer.md) | **Distance** |
| [Rib](tools/rib.md) | **Thickness** |
| [Wrap](tools/wrap.md) | **Depth** |
| [Draft](tools/draft.md) | **Angle** |
| [Shell](tools/shell.md) | **Thickness** |
| [Dome](tools/dome.md) | **Distance** |
| [Hole Wizard](tools/hole-wizard.md) | **Depth** |
| [Thread](tools/thread.md) | **Length** |
| [Cosmetic Thread](tools/cosmetic-thread.md) | **Length** |
| [Mounting Boss](tools/mounting-boss.md) | **Height** |
| [Snap Hook](tools/snap-hook.md) | **Height** |
| [Linear Pattern](tools/linear-pattern.md) | **Spacing** |
| [Circular Pattern](tools/circular-pattern.md) | **Angle** |
| [Move/Copy Body](tools/move-copy-body.md) | **DeltaX**, **DeltaY**, **DeltaZ** |
| [Flex](tools/flex.md) | **TrimPlane1**, **TrimPlane2** |
| [Deform](tools/deform.md) | **Distance** |
| [Freeform](tools/freeform.md) | **Point0+** |
| [Move Face](tools/move-face.md) | **Distance** |
| [Plane](tools/plane.md) | **Distance** |
| [Extruded Surface](tools/extruded-surface.md) | **Depth** |
| [Revolved Surface](tools/revolved-surface.md) | **Angle** |
| [Offset Surface](tools/offset-surface.md) | **Distance** |
| [Extend Surface](tools/extend-surface.md) | **Distance** |
| [Ruled Surface](tools/ruled-surface.md) | **Distance** |
| [Radiate Surface](tools/radiate-surface.md) | **Distance** |
| [Thicken](tools/thicken.md) | **Thickness** |
